All learners in my Accent Reduction sessions have different needs, depending on particular pronunciation issues, so the first session is spent diagnosing pronunciation issues, with exercises provided for home-study and practice.

teacher_info.about_teacher: I am a certified educator with a degree in Secondary English Education, an English Language Arts teaching license, and TEFL certificate. My teaching experience includes working with students for one-on-one tutoring, leading small groups, and full-class instruction at a multicultural school with ESL learners. Additionally, I taught English online to children in China for two years using phonics, grammar, and vocabulary-building strategies. I love helping students on italki achieve their own language goals!
teacher_info.teaching_style: I believe language acquisition is best achieved when language is learned in the same context as it will be used. My lessons include a variety of real-life materials (such as recipes, news articles, role-plays, and video clips), adjusted to the level and interests of each student. This encourages students to view language as a tool to negotiate and share meaning, rather than a set of words and rules to memorized. As a result, students learn in a way that will allow them to be confident using English outside the classroom.

As an English teacher at Long International Middle School in the SLPS (Saint Louis Public Schools) school district, I had the opportunity to work with students from a variety of backgrounds, many of whom were speaking English as a second or third language.
